item.description:
NVBeacon is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH with `nvidia-smi`, process exit alerts, and GPU idle notifications.
- Fixed a crash when opening GPU History after quitting and relaunching NVBeacon within the same minute, for example after an update. History files that already hold a repeated minute are merged when loaded. - Fixed polling on servers whose login shell is csh or tcsh. Remote scripts are now sent in a form that sh, bash, zsh, csh, tcsh, and fish all pass through unchanged. - **Clear Saved Settings** now asks for confirmation before it removes every server, saved password, alert, and the notification history. - A paired Mac-to-iPhone transfer now stays open after the three-minute QR code lifetime, so reviewing servers on the iPhone no longer ends in an expired pairing. - The **System** language setting now uses the first supported language in your macOS preferred languages, instead of Korean whenever Korean appears anywhere in the list. - Turning off a server now removes its last readings from the menu bar totals and the popover overview. - The launch-at-login status now refreshes when Settings opens or NVBeacon becomes active, so changes made in System Settings show up without pressing Refresh. - Replaced the app icon with a new design.
